Fact.Name: Form 8697 item C: pass-through entities holding the contracts
Fact.Description: Form 8697 header item C: each pass-through entity (such as a partnership or an S corporation) in which the filer owns an interest and that holds one or more of the long-term contracts this interest computation relates to. One entry per entity. The face of the form has room for one; with more than one, the first is printed on item C and the form tells the filer to attach a schedule listing them all. Leave it empty when the filer holds the contracts directly.

Fact.Name: Form 8697 item C: employer identification number of the entity
Fact.Description: Form 8697 header item C, "Employer identification number": the EIN of the pass-through entity that holds the long-term contracts.

Fact.Name: Net look-back interest refundable on a separately filed form
Fact.Description: File this claim separately from the income tax return. Do not add it to Form 1040 or Schedule 3 payments. When the IRS pays it, the amount refunded (this figure, or what the IRS actually pays if different) is interest income for the tax year it is received or accrued, entered like any other interest through interest:/interestReports (payer the Internal Revenue Service); it is not income on the return that computes it unless it was also received in that year. The opposite case, /form8697NetInterestOwed, is not deductible by an individual; no module here reads it except Schedule 2 line 17n.

Fact.Name: Form 8697 lines 9b to 9d: direct deposit account for the separate refund
Fact.Description: Form 8697 Part I lines 9b (routing number), 9c (Checking or Savings) and 9d (account number), or the same three boxes on Part II lines 10b to 10d when the simplified marginal impact method is used: the account for a direct deposit of the net look-back interest refund claimed on the separately filed form (/form8697SeparateRefundClaim). One account serves both, because the refund is printed on whichever Part the filer completes. The same validated BankAccount type paymentMethod:/bankAccount and form8888:/form8888AdditionalAccounts/*/writableAccount use, so the instructions' rules ride on the type: the routing number is nine digits whose first two are 01 through 12 or 21 through 32, the account number is up to 17 characters, and exactly one account type is chosen. Leave it unanswered for a refund by check.
